question: What was the value per kg of Luxembourg's exports to EU27 and to non-EU27 partners in 2025?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  year AS period,
  CASE
    WHEN (
      partner_is_eu27_2020 OR (
        partner_is_special AND trade_type = 'intra'
      )
    )
    THEN 'EU27'
    ELSE 'NON_EU27'
  END AS key,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'export'
GROUP BY
  year,
  key,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period,
  value_eur DESC
LIMIT 10000
title: EU27 countries · exports: +0.0 % (2025–2025)
insight: The value per kilogram of Luxembourg's exports in 2025 was 2.14 euros to EU27 countries and 4.20 euros to non-EU27 partners.
The export value per kilogram to non-EU27 countries was almost double that to EU27 countries in 2025.
There was no change in the export value per kilogram to either EU27 or non-EU27 countries during 2025.
Both values per kilogram reached their peak in 2025, with no variation throughout the year.
The data only includes trade rows where quantities are known, so some volumes and unit values may be missing.
